bitPairs.10: this sprite's own $d027+n -- for enemies, the WAVE's colour

colourModel: Three different things share the word colour. The BITMAP PAYLOAD is the 63 bytes and is authoritative. The SPD EDITING COLOUR is what Spritemate shows while drawing and reaches nothing at run time. The RUNTIME COLOUR is what the engine writes to $d027+n, and for the three enemy species it is the wave's authored colour, so one sprite appears in as many colours as there are waves using it.

excluded.role: HUD: heat, score, lives, upgrade pips
excluded.reason: 4 runtime framebuffers (zero at build) + 10 assembler-generated; hires
